results.snippet: Eramet is one of the few mining and metallurgical groups that are still European. Highly international, the group mines nickel, manganese, lithium and mineral sands, notably titanium and zircon, in Indonesia, Africa, Latin America and New Caledonia. It also has refining capacity in France, Norway and the United States. These operations place it at the heart of the energy transition's value chains.
